es: Mediar en una reunión de piso con tacto: exponer una queja, hacer preguntas indirectas, reportar lo dicho y acordar una norma.

teaching.en: Let me mediate: everyone will have two minutes to speak.
teaching.es: Déjenme mediar: cada uno tendrá dos minutos para hablar.
teaching.explanationEs: El mediador ordena los turnos y no toma partido.
teaching.audioText: Let me mediate: everyone will have two minutes to speak.

teaching.en: First on the agenda: the chores, which have been a problem lately.
teaching.es: Lo primero en el orden del día: las tareas, que últimamente han sido un problema.
teaching.explanationEs: Anunciar el orden del día da estructura y evita que la reunión se convierta en una discusión.
segments: First on the agenda: the chores,
which have been a problem lately.
teaching.audioText: First on the agenda: the chores, which have been a problem lately.

teaching.en: I would like to raise something, and I wish we could settle it today.
teaching.es: Me gustaría plantear algo, y ojalá pudiéramos zanjarlo hoy.
teaching.explanationEs: Raise abre un tema con tacto; wish + could expresa el deseo de resolverlo sin presionar.
segments: I would like to raise something, and
I wish we could settle it today.
teaching.audioText: I would like to raise something, and I wish we could settle it today.

teaching.en: I was wondering if we could propose a rota that is fair to everyone.
teaching.es: Me preguntaba si podríamos proponer un cuadrante justo para todos.
teaching.explanationEs: La petición indirecta con I was wondering if… suena a propuesta, no a exigencia.
segments: I was wondering if we could propose
a rota that is fair to everyone.
teaching.audioText: I was wondering if we could propose a rota that is fair to everyone.

teaching.en: Mia asked whether we could settle the chores tonight.
teaching.es: Mia preguntó si podíamos resolver las tareas esta noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Pregunta reportada: whether + sujeto + could, sin inversión.
teaching.audioText: Mia asked whether we could settle the chores tonight.

teaching.en: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, this meeting would be shorter.
teaching.es: Si nos hubiéramos puesto de acuerdo en un orden del día el mes pasado, esta reunión sería más corta.
teaching.explanationEs: If only + had + participio lamenta algo pasado sin culpar a nadie en particular.
segments: If only we had agreed on an agenda
last month, this meeting would be shorter.
teaching.audioText: If only we had agreed on an agenda last month, this meeting would be shorter.

prompt.es: Abres la reunión como mediador. ¿Qué frase es adecuada?

choices.text: Let me mediate: everyone will have two minutes to speak.
Be quiet, I will decide who is right.
Nobody can speak until Tom apologises.

feedback.es: El mediador da turnos iguales y no toma partido; las otras frases imponen o castigan.

hint.es: El mediador da turnos y no toma partido.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Las tareas son lo primero en el orden del día.»

answer.text: The chores are first on the agenda
accepted: The chores are first on the agenda
First on the agenda are the chores

feedback.es: El orden del día se anuncia con first on the agenda para dar estructura a la reunión.

hint.es: Empieza por The chores y termina con on the agenda.

feedback.es: Wish + could expresa un deseo sin presionar; can no se usa después de wish.

hint.es: Wish exige un verbo modal en pasado.

origin.text: I wish we ___ settle it today.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone la hablante.

choices.text: A party for the whole flat.
A cleaning rota for the chores.
A new kitchen for the flat.

feedback.es: La hablante plantea el problema de las tareas y propone un cuadrante con I was wondering if…

origin.audio: I would like to raise something. The chores have been a problem lately. I was wondering if we could propose a cleaning rota.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia preguntó si podíamos empezar el lunes.»

feedback.es: Whether (o if) introduce la pregunta reportada, con el sujeto antes del verbo.

origin.text: Mia asked ___ we could start on Monday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cierra la reunión con un acuerdo y con tacto?

choices.text: Everyone must accept the rota or leave.
I have decided that Tom will do everything.
Are we all happy to start the rota on Monday?

feedback.es: Una pregunta de acuerdo invita a todos a confirmar; las otras imponen o reparten de forma injusta.

prompt.es: Como mediador, escribe lo que dirías en la reunión, de la apertura al acuerdo.

answer.text: Thanks, everyone, for coming. Let me mediate, and I hope we can settle this calmly. First on the agenda: the chores. Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I wish we could keep it tidy together. I am sure nobody wants a problem, and I do not want to blame anyone. I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a small share. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks? Are we all happy with that?
accepted: Thanks, everyone, for coming. Let me mediate, and I hope we can settle this calmly. First on the agenda: the chores. Lately, the kitchen has been a mess, and I wish we could keep it tidy together. I am sure nobody wants a problem, and I do not want to blame anyone. I was wondering if everyone could wash their dishes on the same day. Could I ask whether a rota would suit you from Monday? Mia asked me whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a fair idea. Much as we are all busy, what matters is that each person does a small share. So, shall we agree that we start the rota on Monday, and that we meet again in two weeks? Are we all happy with that?

Good evening, everybody. Let me mediate this meeting, and let us try to settle the chores today. The kitchen has been a mess lately, and I wish we could share the work. I was wondering if each of us could clean one day a week. Could I ask whether Monday would suit everybody? Mia asked whether we could start a cleaning rota, and I think it is a good idea. I understand that some of you are busy, but what matters is that the work is fair. Shall we propose a rota from Monday, and meet again in two weeks to see how it goes? Are we all happy to agree on that?

feedback.es: Una buena mediación abre con orden, expone la queja con wish, pregunta de forma indirecta, reporta a Mia y cierra con un acuerdo.

origin.text: Reunión en tu piso compartido. Como mediador, abre la reunión; expón una queja suave con wish (la cocina desordenada); haz dos preguntas indirectas (I was wondering if…; Could I ask whether…?); reporta lo que preguntó Mia (asked whether…); y propón un acuerdo: turnos de limpieza desde el lunes.

choices.text: Could I ask whether everyone agrees?
Could I ask does everyone agree?
Could I ask whether does everyone agree?

feedback.es: En la pregunta indirecta el orden es afirmativo: whether + sujeto + verbo.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ha prometido Sara.

choices.text: She has promised to start on Monday.
She has not promised to start on Monday yet.
She has refused to join the rota.

feedback.es: Sara usa «bear that in mind» y «could not promise anything»: no ha aceptado ni rechazado.

origin.audio: Ana asked whether we could start the rota on Monday. I said that I would bear that in mind, but I could not promise anything until I checked my timetable.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es fácil que pase; no ha pasado nada.»

feedback.es: Easily done es la fórmula para quitar peso a un error y salvar la cara del otro.

prompt.es: ¿Qué significa «We note with concern…» en lenguaje directo?

choices.text: We are happy with the situation.
We have not read the message.
We are worried and want a change.

feedback.es: We note with concern expresa preocupación y pide que algo cambie; no es neutral.

prompt.es: Reporta con whether la pregunta de Ana sobre el lunes.

answer.text: Ana asked whether we could start on Monday.
accepted: Ana asked whether we could start on Monday.
Ana asked if we could start on Monday.

feedback.es: Con whether o if la pregunta reportada pasa can a could y mantiene el orden afirmativo.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ojalá bajaras la música por la noche.»

feedback.es: Para pedir que alguien cambie un hábito molesto se dice I wish you would + verbo base.

origin.text: I wish you ___ keep the music down at night.
